test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: An aggregate of 36% of the total marks is required to pass an examination and 84% to get a First Class with distinction. A student scored 398 marks and failed by 16 marks. How many marks should the student secure to get a First Class with distinction?
solution:
**Given :**

Total percentage marks required to pass an exam is 36%

84% required to get first distinction.

Student scored 398 marks and failed by 16 marks.

**Calculations :**

Passing marks required for the examination = (398 + 16)

⇒ 36% of total marks = 414

⇒ (36/100) × Total marks = 414

⇒ Total marks = 11.5 × 100

⇒ 1150

84% of total marks required to get first class with distinction

⇒ 84% of 1150

⇒ (84/100) × 1150

⇒ 42 × 23

⇒ 966

**∴ The marks should the student secure to get a First Class with distinction is 966.**
